description: Give someone the reviewer role for a conference, by email address. Use it when the user wants to bring a reviewer onto their programme committee. IMPORTANT and easy to get wrong: this does NOT send anyone an email. If the address already belongs to a verified Congressio account the person becomes a reviewer immediately; otherwise a pending invitation is recorded and activates only when they sign up with that exact address. The response says which happened — relay it accurately, and if it was an invitation tell the user they still need to contact the person themselves. Do not report "I've invited them" as though a message went out. Confirm the address with the user before calling, since a typo grants nothing and silently waits. Requires the user to be an admin of that conference, and an OAuth connection rather than an API key. Requires the organization API key to be configured; without one this returns an error telling the user where to create a key.

categoryIds.description: Track or category ids to scope this reviewer to. Omit to let them review across all tracks.

email.description: The reviewer's email address. Confirm it with the user first.

eventId.description: Event UUID from list_my_events — not the URL slug.

name: add_reviewer
title: Add a reviewer to a conference
